title: C-39: an idle login session is closed by the AFK timeout
notes: The short timeout is deliberate so this scenario can run without waiting for the shipped default.
The server log is the authoritative assertion; the client-facing AFK wording remains a phase acceptance check.

steps.name: the client brings its renderer up
the login window is on the screen
the client sends its authentication request
the client reaches character selection
steps.pattern: The LoginServer has admitted the user

steps.name: the login server records the idle disconnect
steps.pattern: Session \d+ from \S+ was idle for \d+ s, reaching Login\.AfkTimeout of 5 s; sent MSG_DISCONNECT_LOGIN_AFK Warning=\d+ and closed the session
